Oku-Musashi Hanno Tourism Association has released the 2025 Hanno City Tourism Survey results. The survey covered January–December 2025 and gathered responses from Hanno City residents and visitors from outside the city. This is a members-only resource available as a PDF download. A password is required to view it.
